name: Four Card
source:
Main character finds all his household items gone after returning home from camping. There is only a letter on the floor saying that his parents suddenly gone to Bahamas selling the house and entrusting protagonist to his uncle's care. He settles at uncle's place under the same roof with four pretty girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公露营回家后，发现家里的所有物品都不见了。地板上只留着一封信，说他的父母突然去了巴哈马，卖掉房子后把他托付给叔叔照顾。他搬到叔叔家，与四位漂亮女孩住在同一屋檐下。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
